apps.localizedDescription:
AppDump is a customization toolbox that utilizes DarkSword. Supports iOS 16.0 - iOS 18.7.1 & iOS 26.0.x, excluding M5 and A19.
For more information, check out our GitHub! https://github.com/rooootdev/lara. Join the Discord if you need any help! https://discord.gg/gw8PcRF3Jr.
